requirements.statement: The system shall require KYC verification (ID and address match) before allowing loan application submission.
The system shall route an applicant to manual compliance review after two failed automated KYC checks.
The system shall automatically approve a loan application when the amount is below the auto-approval limit and the risk score is acceptable, without human review.
The system shall route applications above the auto-approval limit, or flagged by the fraud model, to a credit officer for manual review.
The system shall allow a credit officer to override the automated credit decision and shall require the officer to record a justification for the override.
The system shall provide the applicant with the specific reason(s) for a loan rejection in writing before finalizing the rejection.
The system shall disburse the approved loan amount only to a bank account registered in the applicant's own name.
The system shall require step-up (second-factor) authentication before allowing a change to a customer's registered bank account or phone number.
The system shall notify both the old and new contact channel when a customer's registered bank account or phone number is changed.
The system shall require compliance officer sign-off before onboarding a politically exposed person.
The system shall maintain an audit trail recording the data used, the credit model's decision, and the identity and timestamp of every approval or rejection.
The system shall return an automated credit decision within 5 seconds for auto-approved applications.
The system shall update the application status visible to the customer within 1 minute of a manual reviewer's action.
The system shall retain completed loan records for a minimum of 7 years for audit purposes, independent of a customer data-deletion request.
The system shall integrate with the existing core banking system for loan disbursement.
The system shall integrate with the existing CRM system for customer records.
